findings.title: Failed stop requests are counted as successful stops
findings.description: `background_tasks_stopped` is set to the number of task IDs attempted, even when `stop_task()` raised for one or more of them. `DispatchAction` exposes this value as metadata, so a dispatch can report agents stopped when they may still be running. Count successful stop requests, or name and record the value as attempts instead.

findings.title: Boolean TOML values pass integer config validation
findings.description: `isinstance(value, int)` accepts booleans in Python. Thus `pipeline.background_idle_timeout_s = true` passes `get_typed_config(..., int)` and becomes a one-second timeout, which can prematurely stop background work. Exclude booleans when validating integer values.

findings.title: Background-dispatch behavior lacks a load test
findings.description: The new session behavior waits on asynchronous SDK streams, applies idle timeouts, and stops background tasks. The added tests use scripted clients, but the existing `tests/load/` tests cover unrelated grep and worktree paths. The review rules require a load test for network/concurrency paths that exercises realistic resource or timing bounds.
